title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The ICSP Development Stream in El Salvador & Guatemala, implemented by partners ORMUSA, El Faro, UNES, ICEFI, CONGCOOP and ISD and Alharaca supports women and marginalised groups to resist regressive human rights policies and strengthen their agency to advance community-based solutions and demand accountability. Focused in Ahuachapán, Sonsonate, La Paz, La Libertad and Morazán in El Salvador and in Sololá and Alta Verapaz in Guatemala, the objectives of the programme are to support marginalised groups to defend their land and human rights, and to support gender and inclusion at different levels, by supporting rights holders to take action to advance their rights; influencing duty bearers and decision-makers to take action, and strengthening the agency of partner agencies and civil society.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: GTM. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Programme objectives are not thematic. The overall programme aims to support rights of women and marginalised individuals and groups and to reduce violence. Work that contributes to specific SDG targets will span all objectives through complementary approaches and actions.Gender equality (and other forms of inclusion) is fundamental to the design of the programme.
